new-customers.title: Invite New Customers
new-customers.description: Reach out to potential buyers who recently joined the platform to expand your customer base. Building relationships early can lead to long-term partnerships and increased order volume.
new-customers.mainPurpose: Grow your customer base by proactively reaching out to new buyers who recently joined the platform and converting them into active customers. Reach out to new buyers who have recently registered on the platform and send them personalized invitations to showcase your product catalog and services.
fullDetails: Identify potential buyers who have recently registered on the platform
Send personalized invitations to showcase your product catalog and services
Highlight unique value propositions and competitive advantages
Offer welcome incentives or special discounts for first-time orders
Build initial relationships through direct communication and follow-up
Track invitation responses and conversion rates
Convert new platform users into loyal, repeat customers

promotions.title: Create Promotions
promotions.description: Boost your sales by creating special offers and discounts for your products. Set up percentage discounts, fixed amount reductions, or bundle deals to attract buyers and drive immediate sales.
promotions.mainPurpose: Create percentage-based discounts for selected products or categories, set up fixed amount reductions for specific items, design bundle deals and buy-one-get-one promotions, define promotion periods with start and end dates, target specific customer segments or buyer groups, set minimum order quantities or spending thresholds, track promotion performance and conversion metrics, schedule promotions for peak seasons or special events.
fullDetails: Create percentage-based discounts for selected products or categories
Set up fixed amount reductions for specific items
Design bundle deals and buy-one-get-one promotions
Define promotion periods with start and end dates
Target specific customer segments or buyer groups
Set minimum order quantities or spending thresholds
Track promotion performance and conversion metrics
Schedule promotions for peak seasons or special events

sales-jobs.title: Sales jobs
sales-jobs.description: Assign and track sales jobs for your team so visits, follow-ups, and targets stay organized.
sales-jobs.mainPurpose: Give each salesperson clear work: who to visit, what to follow up, and which targets to hit. Sales jobs keep that work visible so the team can see what is open, in progress, and done.
fullDetails: Create jobs for visits, follow-ups, and sales targets
Assign each job to a team member
Set what the job covers and when it should be done
Track which jobs are open, in progress, and completed
Review results by salesperson and buyer
